# Synthetic test fixtures — NOT production footage

Everything here is generated by `npm run fixtures` (`tools/make-fixtures.mjs`).
These are deliberately obvious test patterns, never to be shipped:

- **a checkerboard** — stretched media shows as non-square cells
- **a true circle** — an ellipse means the media was distorted
- **four coloured corner markers** — show which edges a cover crop removed
- **a sweeping bar** — lets a test tell a playing video from a static poster

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `landscape-16x9.webm` / `.png` | 1280×720 master stand-in and its poster |
| `portrait-9x16.webm` / `.png` | 720×1280 optional-portrait stand-in |
| `white.png` | Pure white frame, for the worst-case text-contrast check |

The videos are VP8/WebM because the ffmpeg bundled with Playwright is an
encode-only build; they are produced with Chromium's own `MediaRecorder`.
Production footage would normally be supplied as MP4/H.264 — the entrance reads
the container type from the media configuration either way.
